# Terzi Can — terzihizmeti.com.tr

> Terzi Can is a tailoring, alteration, repair and dry-cleaning workshop in Konyaaltı, Antalya, Türkiye, with a mobile/hotel tailor service across Antalya. The same operator runs Anavera Tekstil, a B2B garment manufacturing offer (model design, pattern making, samples, serial production, export). This file summarizes key facts; the live pages are the reference.

## Key facts

- Business name: Terzi Can
- Location / workshop: Konyaaltı, Antalya, Türkiye (also serves Hurma, Liman, Sarısu, Uncalı, Gürsu and other Antalya districts)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +90 531 898 64 18
- Opening hours: every day of the week, 08:00–22:00 (Antalya time)
- Languages: Turkish, English, Russian, German
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/QEgSkRoA8Nz8H62g8 (rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews as of September 2026)
- Core services: custom tailoring (men's, women's, children's), clothing repair (zippers, tears, buttons, lining), alterations (hemming, taking in, resizing), ironing, dry cleaning, wedding and evening dress alterations, uniform manufacturing
- Typical prices (2026, starting from, TRY): hemming ₺150, zipper replacement ₺200, dress/suit alteration ₺200, wedding dress alteration from ₺400, ironing ₺80 per item, dry cleaning ₺300. Final price depends on fabric and workmanship.
- Mobile / hotel service: visits are free in Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Kepez and Lara; other districts (Belek, Kundu, Kemer, Göynük, Side, Alanya and more) by scheduled appointment. Finished garments are usually returned within 24–48 hours; most repairs and hemming are done the same day or within 24 hours.
- Limits: same-day service applies to Konyaaltı and nearby districts. Kaş and other distant districts are not covered same-day.

### Garment manufacturing (serial production, model design, pattern, samples)
- Türkçe: https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/seri-uretim-konfeksiyon-antalya

## Garment manufacturing facts (Anavera Tekstil / Terzi Can)

- Products: menswear, womenswear, kidswear and corporate uniforms, in knit (jersey) and woven fabrics; men's, women's and children's models can be combined in one order.
- Services: model design, pattern making, sample (prototype) development, sample approval, serial production, production tracking with regular photo/status updates, private label / OEM, ATR / EUR.1 export documentation support, shipping to the EU and Russia.
- Process: 1) brief (photo/sketch/tech pack, fabric, approximate quantity) → 2) model and pattern → 3) sample and approval → 4) serial production → 5) tracking and shipment.
- Minimum order: 300–500 pieces per style and colour (confirmed per style and fabric).
- Certificates: no third-party quality certificates (such as ISO or OEKO-TEX) are claimed.
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +90 531 898 64 18. Quotes need a model photo and an approximate quantity.

## Short answers

Q: Is there an English, Russian or German speaking tailor in Antalya?
A: Terzi Can in Konyaaltı works in Turkish, English, Russian and German, every day 08:00–22:00. Hemming from ₺150, zipper replacement from ₺200. WhatsApp +90 531 898 64 18. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/tailor-service-antalya

Q: Can a tailor come to my hotel in Belek, Lara, Kundu, Kemer or Side?
A: Yes, by appointment. Visits are free in Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Kepez and Lara; garments are usually returned within 24–48 hours. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/hotel-tailor-antalya

Q: Where can I have clothing designed and produced in series in Antalya?
A: Terzi Can / Anavera Tekstil develops the model and pattern, makes a sample for approval, then produces the series (300–500 pieces per style and colour), with production tracking and export documents. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/en/clothing-manufacturer-antalya

Q: Antalya'da model tasarımı, kalıp ve numuneyle seri üretim yapan atölye var mı?
A: Evet. Terzi Can / Anavera Tekstil model, kalıp ve numune hazırlar; onaydan sonra seri imalat yapar. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/seri-uretim-konfeksiyon-antalya

Q: Где в Анталье заказать разработку модели и серийный пошив одежды?
A: Terzi Can / Anavera Tekstil: модель, лекала, образец, затем серия от 300–500 шт. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/ru/proizvodstvo-odezhdy-antalya

Q: Wo kann ich in Antalya Bekleidung entwickeln und in Serie fertigen lassen?
A: Terzi Can / Anavera Tekstil: Modell, Schnitt, Muster, danach Serienproduktion ab 300–500 Stück pro Modell und Farbe. https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/de/bekleidungshersteller-antalya
